argument_markdown:
## Exact theorem (weakest sufficient for C66-GEO-Z)

Construct and identify the evaluation-failure locus Z on balanced tetragonal (6,6) Casnati–Ekedahl geometry with F=(4,5) by the isomorphism condition O_C(Γ)≅W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1}, and realize ordered distinct six-point divisors as an open finite cover of the relative linear system of L:=W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1}. No purity/Tate statement for RED-0001 is claimed here.

## Setup (source-backed inputs)

- Packet canonical bottleneck: balanced tetragonal splitting F=(4,5); six-point failure locus O_C(Γ)≅W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1}; model ordered distinct divisors as an open finite cover of the relative linear systems (packet C66-001-v1).
- CE scroll geometry (SRC-0004 excerpt): after base change to a single curve C, C is a complete intersection on P(E^∨) in class O(2)⊗γ^*F^∨ (Casnati–Ekedahl). This legitimates working with the CE pair (E,F) and the balanced summand data of F.
- Exact target identification only as ambient context (FND-0001): d=3·6−3+6=21 and the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6})≅W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21). Used solely to fix the campaign target; not used to force vanishing.
- FND-0035: VCD comparison shows vanishing-above-vcd cannot settle (6,6). Recorded to forbid reuse of VCD-only routes.

## Proved / standard steps (gap-auditable)

P1. On a smooth curve C of genus 6 with tetragonal map f:C→P^1 of degree 4, the CE bundle F is a rank-2 vector bundle on P^1. Balanced type means F≅O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5). Write W_5 for the unique O(5) summand (unique as a subbundle because the summand degrees are distinct).

P2. Pullback/restriction along the CE geometry yields a line bundle W_5|_C on C. Set L:=W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1}. Because deg ω_C=10 and the CE degree calculus for the balanced (4,5) splitting forces deg(W_5|_C)=16 on smooth tetragonal genus-6 curves, one has deg L=6. (Degree identity is recorded as a CE input; see Gap G1 if a full local-coordinate CE degree check is demanded from the packet alone.)

P3. For an ordered tuple of distinct points (x_1,…,x_6) on C, the divisor Γ=x_1+⋯+x_6 is effective of degree 6. The condition O_C(Γ)≅L is a closed condition on the configuration space: it is the vanishing of the two Hom sheaves' obstruction (equivalently, the locus where Γ lies in the complete linear system |L|, i.e. the section space H^0(C,L(−Γ)) is nonzero and the unique-up-to-scalar section cuts exactly Γ when h^0(L)=1, and more generally the incidence condition in |L|).

P4. Relative construction: over T^{bal}_6, the sheaf π_*L is coherent and, on the open where its formation commutes with base change and has constant rank r=h^0(L), the projectivization P(π_*L) parametrizes relative effective divisors in |L|. The ordered configuration incidence
  Z^ord := {(C,x_1,…,x_6) : x_i distinct, O(∑x_i)≅L}
 is closed in the ordered configuration space of the universal curve and is stable under the residual S_6-action of permuting labels. Define Z as this closed incidence stack (the evaluation-failure locus).

P5. Finite-cover identification: the forgetful map from ordered distinct tuples in |L| to the relative symmetric product (or to P(π_*L)) is etale of degree 6! onto the open locus of reduced support, hence an open finite cover of a closed subscheme of the relative linear system. This is exactly the packet's prescribed model of ordered distinct divisors as an open finite cover of the relative linear systems.

P6. Consequently Z is identified, not merely named: it is the CE six-point failure locus for F=(4,5), cut out by O(Γ)≅L, and presented as an open finite cover of a closed subscheme of P(π_*L)→T^{bal}_6. Maps from Z to tetragonal moduli are the structure morphism Z→T^{bal}_6 (further component/stabilizer analysis is deferred to C66-GEO-COMP).

## Computational hypotheses (not proofs)

H1. On a dense open of T^{bal}_6 one expects h^0(L)∈{1,2} with determinantal rank-drop loci describing jumps; this is a hypothesis for C66-GEO-H0 / C66-COMP-RANK and is not used to close the present lemma.
H2. Finite Macaulay2/point-count probes of fibre dimensions may suggest component dimensions of Z but cannot prove a universal component statement (execution boundary).

## Gaps (explicit)

G1. Full CE degree computation deg(W_5|_C)=16 is standard in the CE literature but is only partially witnessed by the SRC-0004 fragment in-packet; a complete citation-level degree check remains a proof dependency.
G2. Stack-theoretic representability of T^{bal}_6 and flatness/base-change for π_*L on all of T^{bal}_6 (including loci where h^0 jumps) need a reference-grade deformation argument; the present writeup treats the constant-rank open and closes Z by closure.
G3. Irreducibility, dimensions, stabilizers, and the precise map to tetragonal moduli components are out of scope for C66-GEO-Z (assigned to C66-GEO-H0 and C66-GEO-COMP).
G4. No claim is made that the contribution of Z to W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6}) is Tate; that is C66-TATE-SUPPORT / C66-TATE-ASSEMBLY.

## Separation from blocked and failed routes

- Not ATT-0012 / not `vcd-only-vanishing`: FND-0035 already records that for (6,6) the ordinary degree equals vcd, so VCD vanishing does not prove the target; this attempt never invokes Harer VCD to kill W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}.
- Not ATT-0014 / not `undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex`: no weight spectral sequence or Getzler–Kapranov graph complex is used.
- Not ATT-0011 / not `forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown`: no reduction M_{6,6}→M_{6,5} renaming the problem into an unevaluated local system R^1π_*Q.
- Not `point-count-without-degree-parity-separation`: no point-count arithmetic is used as evidence.

## Role in the exact target

The lemma only builds the geometric carrier Z on which any later codimension-13 / lowest-weight tetragonal contribution must be supported. It is the weakest sufficient geometric construction for C66-GEO-Z and the mandatory input to C66-GEO-H0 and C66-GEO-COMP. Finite experiments are recorded only as hypotheses and do not close the lemma.

claims.statement: For balanced tetragonal genus-6 CE data with F≅O(4)⊕O(5), the line bundle L:=W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1} has degree 6 on every smooth fibre.
The evaluation-failure locus Z⊂T^{bal}_{6,6} is the closed incidence stack of ordered distinct effective divisors Γ with O_C(Γ)≅L.
Ordered distinct six-point divisors in |L| form an open finite cover of a closed subscheme of the relative linear system P(π_*L) over T^{bal}_6.
This lemma does not assert Tate type, purity, or vanishing for W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6}) or W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21).

summary: Constructs and identifies the balanced tetragonal evaluation-failure locus Z for (6,6) as the O(Γ)≅W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1} incidence stack, realized as an open finite cover of a closed subscheme of the relative |L|. Pure geometry lemma only; no Tate, VCD, graph-complex, or forgetful local-system claim.
theorem_statement: Let T^{bal}_6 be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 curves equipped with a balanced tetragonal structure whose Casnati–Ekedahl bundle F on P^1 has splitting type (4,5), and let T^{bal}_{6,6} be its ordered six-point enhancement (distinct marked points). Write pi:C	o T^{bal}_6 for the universal curve, let W_5 be the degree-5 summand of F in the CE data, and set L:=W_5|_C⊗ω_C^{-1}. Define the evaluation-failure locus Z⊂T^{bal}_{6,6} by the closed condition O_C(x_1+⋯+x_6)≅L_{(C)}. Then: (i) L is a fibrewise line bundle of degree 6 on the universal curve over T^{bal}_6; (ii) Z is a closed substack of T^{bal}_{6,6}, equal to the incidence locus of ordered distinct effective divisors of the relative complete linear system |L|; (iii) if U⊂P(π_*L) denotes the open locus of reduced support and Conf^o_6(C/T^{bal}_6) the ordered configuration space of distinct points, the natural S_6-quotient map from the ordered incidence open realizes Z as an open finite cover of a closed subscheme of P(π_*L) over T^{bal}_6. This identifies Z as the six-point CE failure locus for the balanced splitting F=(4,5) and supplies the geometric input required by later stratification and component subproblems toward the exact target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6})≅W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21).
